location: CH-BE, Bachmann-Geiser cat. no. 203; inv. no. 24911a-b; ex Kirchgemeinde Pieterlen.
remarks: Two fragments, slide sec. (outer and inner slides)  and end of bell sec. Slide frozen, hence bore cannot be measured. Damage in asc. slide tube between stays. Sleeve-type repair on desc. tube of outer slide at proximal end. Ferrules at slide stays have dragon-scale pattern. Slide stays highly ornamented with floral-leaf pattern. Bachmann-Geiser dates the fragments as “2. Hälfte 18. Jhr. (?),” but the ornamentation on the slide stays is more like a late-seventeenth- or early-eighteenth-century instrument. Abschlussringe und Zwingen mit eingravierten Rillen. The bell opening, however, is too large for an a tenor of ca. 1700. See under instrument #1700 for further detail on the instrument’s use. Examined by the author, June 1999.****See under 1700. Bachmann-Geiser 1998 says three fragments
